description: Production-grade, remote-first navigation system for Apple TV and Android TV platforms with D-pad support, focus management, long-press interactions, and spatial navigation with memory.

subtasks.title: Create TVNavigationContext.tsx

acceptance_criteria: Context provides last focused items per screen
Context provides context menu visibility state

subtasks.notes: Created TVNavigationContext.tsx with complete TV navigation state management: focus history stack, per-screen focus memory, voice search state, context menu state, and utility functions. subtasks.title: Create useTVEventHandler.ts hook

Supports all TV events: up, down, left, right, select, menu, playPause
subtasks.notes: Created useTVEventHandler.ts hook with proper lifecycle management. Hook enables TVEventHandler on mount, disables on unmount. Includes existence check for TVEventHandler (may not be available in all builds). Supports all TV events: up, down, left, right, select, menu, playPause, longSelect. Added utility hooks (useIsTV, useTVEventHandlerAvailable) and event type guards. Committed as 85d6355e.

subtasks.title: Create useLongPress.ts hook
subtasks.description: Create platform-aware long-press detection hook with 300ms threshold for Apple TV (timer-based) and native event for Android TV
acceptance_criteria: Distinguishes between short press (<300ms) and long press (>=300ms)
Uses timer-based detection for Apple TV
Uses native longSelect event on Android TV
Properly cleans up timers on unmount
subtasks.notes: Created useLongPress.ts with platform-aware long-press detection. Features: (1) useLongPress hook for general-purpose detection with onPressIn/onPressOut handlers, (2) useLongPressWithTVEvents hook for TV remote integration that uses native longSelect on Android TV and timer-based 300ms detection on Apple TV, (3) Proper timer cleanup on unmount to prevent memory leaks, (4) Utility functions to check platform capabilities. Committed as 00c3320b.

subtasks.title: Create useSpatialNavigation.ts hook
subtasks.description: Create hook for spatial navigation with focus memory storage/retrieval and nextFocus logic with node handle management
acceptance_criteria: Uses findNodeHandle for native node access
subtasks.notes: Created useSpatialNavigation.ts hook with comprehensive spatial navigation support. Features: (1) Focus memory storage/retrieval via TVNavigationContext integration, (2) Node handle management using findNodeHandle() for nextFocus props, (3) Support for nextFocusUp/Down/Left/Right with automatic handle resolution, (4) Auto focus restoration on screen navigation using useFocusEffect with requestAnimationFrame, (5) Graceful handling of missing refs and non-TV platforms, (6) Utility hooks: useFocusableRef, useFocusHandlers, useGridNavigation. Committed as 49d50219.

subtasks.title: Create TVContextMenu.tv.tsx component

subtasks.title: Create TVVoiceSearch.tv.tsx component

Also created TVVoiceSearch.tsx as non-TV fallback. Exports VoiceSearchResult type for search result items.

phases.name: Navigation Integration
phases.description: Integrate focus memory with React Navigation and ensure proper focus restoration

subtasks.title: Enhance AppNavigator.tsx with focus restoration
subtasks.description: Integrate useFocusEffect with focus restoration logic, store focus state in navigation.setParams()
acceptance_criteria: Stores focus ID in route params via navigation.setParams()
Uses requestAnimationFrame for timing (screen focus fires before layout)
Wraps callbacks in useCallback to prevent infinite loops
Uses setNativeProps({ hasTVPreferredFocus: true }) for runtime focus
subtasks.notes:
Implemented TV focus restoration integration with React Navigation:

1. Created useTVFocusRestoration hook (src/hooks/useTVFocusRestoration.ts) that provides:
   - useFocusEffect integration for automatic focus restoration on screen navigation
   - navigation.setParams({lastFocusId}) for focus state persistence
   - requestAnimationFrame timing for proper layout completion
   - setNativeProps({hasTVPreferredFocus: true}) for runtime focus changes
   - useCallback wrapping to prevent infinite loops

2. Created TVScreenWrapper component (src/components/tv/TVScreenWrapper.tv.tsx) that:
   - Provides context-based focus management via TVScreenFocusContext
   - Integrates with TVNavigationContext for global state
   - Auto-restores focus on screen mount using useFocusEffect
   - Saves focus on screen blur to navigation params

3. Updated AppNavigator.tsx:
   - Added TVNavigationProvider wrapper around the app root
   - Added TVFocusParams type with lastFocusId to all route params
   - Documented the TV focus restoration patterns

4. Created src/hooks/index.ts for centralized hook exports

Committed as 55301216.

subtasks.title: Implement back button behavior handling
subtasks.description: Ensure TV remote back/menu button consistently navigates to previous screen without unexpected exits
acceptance_criteria: Back button returns to previous screen in stack
Focus returns to trigger element after modal close
subtasks.notes:
Implemented consistent TV back button behavior:

1. Created useTVBackHandler hook (src/hooks/useTVBackHandler.ts):
   - Handles TV remote back/menu button with proper priority
   - Integrates with TVNavigationContext to close modals first
   - Supports custom back press handlers for screen-level customization
   - Provides useTVNavigationBackHandler for navigation-aware back handling
   - Provides useTVBackWithFocusRestore for focus restoration after modal close

2. Created TVBackHandler component (src/components/tv/TVBackHandler.tv.tsx):
   - Global back button handler at app level
   - Closes context menus and voice search before navigating back
   - Handles Android TV hardware back button via BackHandler
   - Handles Apple TV menu button via TVEventHandler
   - Provides setTVNavigationBackHandler/clearTVNavigationBackHandler for external integration

3. Created TVNavigationBackHandlerProvider component:
   - Navigation-aware back handler that integrates with React Navigation
   - Prevents unexpected app exits at root screens (MainTabs, Home, Onboarding)
   - Registers with global TVBackHandler for proper priority handling

4. Updated AppNavigator.tsx:
   - Wrapped InnerNavigator with TVBackHandler at provider level
   - Added TVNavigationBackHandlerProvider inside navigation structure
   - Updated documentation with TV back button behavior

5. Updated hooks/index.ts to export new hooks

Committed as f35ccf67.

subtasks.title: Add TVNavigationProvider to app root
subtasks.description: Wrap app with TVNavigationContext provider for global TV state access
subtasks.notes: TVNavigationProvider already wraps entire app via AppNavigator.tsx (lines 1655-1670). subtasks.notes:
Created HomeScreen.tv.tsx with complete TV navigation support:

1. **All sections navigable via D-pad**: Hero section, continue watching, this week section, and all catalog sections are fully navigable using D-pad.

2. **Focus memory persists on return**: Uses useSpatialNavigation hook with autoRestoreFocus enabled. Focus state is saved via TVNavigationContext and restored when navigating back to home screen.

- Focusable wrapper on Load More and Add Catalogs buttons for complete D-pad coverage
- TV-optimized layout with larger spacing, fonts, and touch targets
- Section ref management via getCatalogSectionRef for dynamic catalog sections
- handleSectionFocus callback for focus tracking and memory persistence
